name: Dettenheim (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided white over blue, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Dettenheim (a white horseshoe below a wavy bar on blue).
history: Municipal flag of Dettenheim; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Dettenheim arms — horseshoe and wavy bar on blue
